question: Elastic fibres of periodontal ligament which regulate the vascular flow:
exp:
Periodontal ligament consists of principal fibres and elastic fibres. Principal fibres are made up of collagen type I. They are purely collagenous.
The elastic fibres are present in two immature forms called oxytalan and elaunin (AIIMS-07). Oxytalan fibres run parallel to the root surface and are attached to the blood vessels thus they regulate the vascular flow.

question: Which nerve biopsy is taken to diagnose neuritic leprosy?
exp: Neuritic leprosy - only nerve involved no skin involvement. - Slit Skin smear(SSS) - negative - Nerve thickening - confirms diagnosis. A purely sensory thickened peripheral nerve should be sampled as there are chances of nerve damage during biopsy If its a motor nerve--> deformity . Therefore, option median & ulnar are ruled out. So Radial cutaneous branch is used for sampling during nerve biopsy.
